def min_weight_difference(N, weights):
    total_sum = sum(weights)
    current_sum = 0
    min_diff = float('inf')

    for i in range(N - 1):
        current_sum += weights[i]
        diff = abs(total_sum - 2 * current_sum)
        min_diff = min(min_diff, diff)

    return min_diff
